Can a handful of 16 GB Mac minis run a model none of them can hold alone?

That's what I am building, a small open-source coordinator. 

Each Mac mini M4 registers as a node. 

The coordinator reads the model's real per-layer sizes and gives each Mac a contiguous slice of layers
